name: Saddle of Good Hope
body:
Aura moderate enchantment; CL 7th; Slot body (see below); Price 23,625 gp; Weight 30 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This military saddle has a golden glow about it that easily marks it as magical. The saddle must be worn by a horse, yet, its powers are granted to whomever is sitting on the saddle. The user is able to cast good hope three times per day. The spell affects both the user and the horse.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, good hope; Cost 11,813 gp.
